about_the_game:
It's a traditional jrpg game, turn-based with unique moments and a fascinating story focused on the purple light’s past.

The Story:

Thays Tanari and Dunar Moonsong embark on an extremely dangerous journey to find the five elements in Dimension Two. They end up making a new friend in this dimension.

The three girls join together to explore Dimension Two, but they have no idea that it is dominated by Subtwo and Zhenya Zarale.

During this journey, Dunar discovers that Dimension Two hides secrets about the purple light’s past, and she needs to solve all the questions involving her own past.

Note: In this demo, you can only play the beginning of the story.

Key features:

•This demo offers about 1 hour of gameplay. (The full game has over 30 hours of content.)

• In this demo, you can explore 1 city and 1 dungeon. (The full game includes 3 worlds with many regions to explore.)

• Female characters available to play;

• Monster bestiary to complete;

• Turn-based battles;

• Trade items with NPCs; (Not available in this demo.)

• Only Thays is playable in this demo; 

• Colorful environments;

• One bloody environment; (Not available in this demo.)

• Over 1 hour of original soundtrack; (Only a few tracks are included in this demo.)

• Rich story and plenty of dialogue;

• Each city has its own unique NPCs — no reused characters;

• Two endings to discover; (Only in the full game.)

content_descriptors.notes:
In the Tower of Torment, the setting has a horror atmosphere, partly inspired by movies like Saw.
This area includes blood-covered windows, bloody walls, monsters with open bodies, spikes, armless creatures, zombies, floating heads, and a villain with a serial killer or psychopathic personality.

In the Himba Tribe (or Himba Village), NPCs appear with exposed breasts, as the location is inspired by the real-life culture of the Himba people.
However, nipples are not shown, and the graphics follow a 32-bit style, with low visual detail.
